decisions.collectorChecklist: 660 base cards: 1-653 plus seven unnumbered checklists.
decisions.checklistNumbering: CL-DK and CL1-CL6 are stable VCS identifiers for physically unnumbered checklists.
decisions.subsets: Diamond Kings 1-26; six back-designated Rated Rookies at 52,126,547,574,579,649. All retained in base.
decisions.variations: One canonical checklist position per number. Prefer corrected and later source states; CL-DK uses Check List reverse. #639 uses corrected Angels glove with green border.
decisions.exclusions: Ty Cobb three-piece puzzle panels are non-card accompaniments, not extra checklist positions. Ty Cobb #653 puzzle-picture baseball card retained. Separate oversized Action All-Stars product excluded.
decisions.mascotTeam: #645 The Chicken has no team affiliation; intentionally blank. Current importer requires --allow-pending-teams for this known exception.
